topologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

topologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
topologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.

importOrder.action: Parse and validate all 12 Vikingaleden section packets.
Normalize trail-level metadata from trail.research.json and preserve aliases: Viking Trail, Vikingaleden Roslagen, Paxwalk Vikingaleden.
Import sections 1-6 with Naturkartan GPX geometry and no Upplandsleden route overlap.
Normalize sections 7-12 against Upplandsleden sections 11-16 before creating runtime facilities or route aliases.
Create canonical facility/place clusters for overlapping endpoint facilities using the Upplandsleden dedupe policies.
Keep pending rows pending and keep suppressions, leakage, transport metadata, no-water/no-car metadata, and rule warnings out of visible facilities.
Run generated-data validation only after normalization creates runtime files; this handoff is research-only.

decisionsApplied.decision: Keep the 12-section Vikingaleden candidate topology, write trail-scoped Vikingaleden route files for all sections, and preserve sections 7-12 as a selectable Upplandsleden-overlap chain with deduped facility/place records.

remainingGeometryWork: Run publication-time checks for volatile route notices, fire rules, seasonal services and transit before exposing the route as final.
